name: Paper2Galgame
description: Turn academic papers into interactive visual novel dialogues with anime-style character narration, quizzes, and choices.

defaultReadingMode.title: Default reading mode
defaultReadingMode.description: fast = only Abstract/Method/Experiment; detailed = all chapters.

chunkSize.title: Chunk size (characters)
chunkSize.description: Maximum characters per text chunk for non-section-split PDFs.

chunkOverlap.title: Chunk overlap (characters)
chunkOverlap.description: Overlap between adjacent chunks to preserve context.

maxReturnedChunks.title: Max returned chunks
maxReturnedChunks.description: Safety limit to avoid returning too many chunks in one call.

defaultProviderId.title: Default LLM provider
defaultProviderId.description: Preferred LLM provider for script generation (e.g. deepseek, openai). Leave empty to auto-detect.

defaultModel.title: Default LLM model
defaultModel.description: Preferred model name (e.g. deepseek-chat, gpt-4o-mini). Leave empty to auto-detect.
